source_identity.candidate: Preregistered cheap learned gate for selectively paying a diverse seeded BDD-order restart
source_identity.join_rule: Exact reasoning source blob plus explicit C586 heading only; later same-worker artifacts are follow-up evidence, not independent candidate identities.

claim_under_audit: On the frozen v0 synthetic split, a cheap structural predictor can selectively invoke a costly seeded third start, match always-three final ROBDD quality, and save about 19.17% candidate compilations; this motivates amortizing rare expensive restarts with a cheap learned predictor.

v2_transfer_results_pin.note: Contents API at the frozen note SHA and at this creation commit agree on the 24-case result. A contradictory stale structured fetch was quarantined and not used semantically.

v0_aggregate_recalculation.method: Recomputed all aggregate sums/confusion/AUROC directly from the 16 stored test records without using the stored aggregate fields.
v0_aggregate_recalculation.caution: There is only one positive test example. A 1/1 observed recall does not establish stable recall.

v0_predictor_structural_replay.method: Reimplemented the persisted structural feature/probability path and regenerated frozen quartic n=14 cases 882500..882503.

historical_compile_accounting_replay.observation: No v0 runner is persisted. Running the currently persisted v1-runner semantics reproduces the critical v0 live endpoints and probabilities but not stored candidate-compilation counts: seed 882501 replays two/three counts 519/717 versus stored v0 479/664. Likewise v1 seed 883010 replays the stored live endpoints but yields two/three 708/949 versus stored v1 662/888.
historical_compile_accounting_replay.likely_mechanism: The persisted v1 neighbors(order) enumerates all remove/reinsert positions without deduplication. For n=16 it produces 240 entries but only 225 unique permutations. Historical stored outputs appear to use a unique-candidate accounting convention. This mechanism explains the direction and scale of the count gap, but the absent historical v0 runner prevents proving the exact old implementation contract.
historical_compile_accounting_replay.scope: This is an exact-replay/accounting defect, not evidence that the stored endpoint live-node values are false.

v1_same_worker_confirmation.test_scope: Outcome-aware quartic n=16, 20 untouched fixed seeds, frozen v0 predictor and threshold.
v1_same_worker_confirmation.interpretation: The frozen predictor retained 2/2 positives but collapsed to always-three and did not reproduce v0 selectivity or compute savings. This is same-worker confirmatory evidence, not independent replication.

v2_same_worker_multifamily_transfer.test_scope: 24 fixed n=16 synthetic cases: six each cubic, quartic, Watts-Strogatz and Erdos-Renyi; frozen v0 predictor, features and threshold.
v2_same_worker_multifamily_transfer.label_target_misalignment: A quartic positive (seed 884102) has seeded lowest one-stage live count, yet the final two-arm endpoint is 126 versus always-three/seeded-path 138; the one-stage binary label therefore is not a safe proxy for final controller utility. In the Erdos family the frozen gate misses the sole positive and incurs +7 final live-node regret.
v2_same_worker_multifamily_transfer.runner_replay: Representative current v2 cases replayed from the persisted v2 runner with exact stored stage/live/compile/probability values, unlike the older v1 compile-accounting mismatch.

external_independent_replication.note: All confirmatory/transfer evidence audited here is produced by the same CLEAN reasoning worker lineage; it must not be labelled third-party independent replication.

grades.v1_same_worker_confirmatory_evidence: B+ outcome evidence / C+ exact historical compile-accounting replay
grades.v2_preregistered_transfer_artifact: A- on representative replay and stored endpoint-oracle checks
grades.general_selective_cost_amortization_clai: C on this frozen v0 model/threshold/one-stage label beyond the original split

supported: The exact v0 stored 16-case split exhibits the claimed final-quality match and about 19.17% candidate-compilation saving.
The frozen predictor feature/probability path and critical rare-positive endpoint behavior are reproducible from persisted artifacts.
Cheap structural routing remains a plausible mechanism family worth testing when target, accounting and safety are preregistered.
not_supported: Stable classifier generalization from the v0 AUROC/recall numbers; positives are too sparse.
A general claim that the frozen v0 gate safely amortizes seeded restarts without quality loss: v1 loses selectivity and v2 fails its preregistered quality-safety criterion.
The one-stage seeded-win label as a reliable proxy for final utility.
Exact historical compilation-count replay from the currently persisted v1 runner.
Any proof-search or general BDD production policy conclusion outside these synthetic positive-monotone graph 2-CNF experiments.

scope_guard: Do not generalize the v2 failure to learned restart routing as a family. It applies to the exact frozen v0 model, threshold, features, seeded-start construction, one-stage label, controller and synthetic transfer distributions audited here. Do not use C586 to steer clean exploration workers.
reopen_conditions: A source-matched historical v0 runner or immutable accounting receipt explains and reproduces the stored candidate-compilation convention.
A new untouched preregistered holdout evaluates a target aligned to final utility or explicit cost-regret and passes a prespecified quality-safety criterion.
A protocol-matched independent replication or failure report appears.
A materially revised predictor/gate is frozen before outcomes with enough positive-event power to estimate false-negative regret.
exact_next_action: Do not repeat unchanged C586. On the next valid invocation freeze then-current control, verify then-current ACTIVE_WAVE/source integrity, and select a different exact source member with runnable artifacts or raw outputs that permit independent numerical reconstruction.
